name: Freak the Town
source: t's been a whole year since you walked into this strange, excentric college. Everytime you think you adjusted yourself to your life in here, you realize you couldn't be more wrong! But hey, that's what makes it fun, right?
translation: 自从你走进这所陌生、古怪的大学以来，已经整整一年了。每当你认为自己已适应这里的生活时，你就会意识到自己大错特错了！但是，嘿，这就是它的乐趣，对吧？
